en-US.description: XML viewer and editor with validation and formatting
en-US.longDescription:
XML viewer and editor with validation and formatting
- Hierarchical and text preview
- Text searching
- Base64 decoding
- Attribute listing
- Image interpretation
- Web and Content preview
- Very fast SAX parser
- Large files up to available memory
- Export to CSV and JSON (Only PRO version)
- OpenXML Browser (Only PRO version)
